narrative.northStar: The Field Manual, Revised for Screen
narrative.overview: This is a document that happens to be a website, made for the Hong Kong Adventure Corps. It borrows the authority of a 1950s infantry pamphlet — numbered sections, a margin rail, a plate with callout keys, tabular data — and rebuilds it with the precision of a modern screen: a variable grotesque, live vector linework, and one red field that does real work. The object is treated with technical respect, never militarist theatre. There is no camouflage, no neon, no faux paper, no tactical dark mode. The frame owns the world; the reading column stays calm. The masthead, the numbered rail, the section openers, the plate controls and the single safety field carry the oxide red and the expanded Archivo voice. The body text sits at a real measure in a workhorse sans, on a cool paper ground, with hairline rules doing the structural work. The exploded plate is a 3D technical plate: a true side elevation with a solid oblique side face, lit from the top-left. It is not a rotatable model, shaded render, or drop-shadowed card. The cycle is a flat two-dimensional schematic with a moving cartridge. The rifle is drawn in its real material split: dark Maranyl furniture against light parkerised steel, with the black magazine as the third tone.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper, near-black ink, one oxide-red accent.
One self-hosted variable family, Archivo, used across three width settings.
A 3D extruded exploded plate and a flat two-dimensional six-step cycle.
Dark Maranyl furniture against light parkerised steel.
A bilingual reading layer: English default, Traditional Chinese on demand.
The Hong Kong Adventure Corps identity: crest, unit name, oxide accent and copyright line; no motto.

rules.name: The One Red Field Rule
rules.body: The accent may own exactly one large region per page — the safety panel. Everywhere else it is a stroke, a number, a tab, or a hover, never a wash.

rules.name: The Paper Is the Page Rule
rules.body: No gradients, glass, blur, faux fibre or drop shadows. Depth comes from tonal paper steps, hairlines, and the plate's engineering grid. The grid appears only inside the plate.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Display and headline settings may use Archivo's width axis. Body copy never does. The width change is the hierarchy device; adding a second display face is not.

rules.name: The Small Caps Are Labels Rule
rules.body: Tracked uppercase is reserved for labels, controls and figure keys. It never sets a paragraph.

rules.name: The Extrusion Rule
rules.body: The exploded plate is a front elevation plus a solid side face. The side is geometry, never a shadow, gradient, blur or bevel. The depth and direction are fixed across every plate part; the cycle stays flat.

dos: Do use exactly one oxide-red field per page; the safety panel is that field.
Do set display and headline type with Archivo's width axis; keep body at 100% width.
Do use 1px hairlines and paper tones for structure; the page is flat.
Do keep the 80px engineering grid inside the plate; the reading column stays clean.
Do extrude the exploded plate along one 45° vector with a solid side face and an ink back edge; keep the cycle flat.
Do draw the buttstock as a long straight-comb wedge with a slanted buttplate, toe swivel and visible wrist; dark Maranyl against light metal.
Do use the Hong Kong Adventure Corps crest and unit name; the copyright line is © 2026 Hong Kong Adventure Corps. All rights reserved. There is no motto.
Do keep the Chinese layer paired span-for-span with the English.
donts: Don't add gradients, glass, blur, drop shadows, or rounded cards.
Don't turn the figure depth into a cast shadow, gradient, bevel or specular highlight.
Don't simplify the buttstock back into a rounded rectangle or a generic wedge without the wrist, buttplate and toe swivel.
Don't use the accent as a background outside the safety panel.
Don't use a second display face or a monospace costume for technical labels.
Don't add kickers or eyebrows above headings; the number rail and the heading carry the structure.
Don't animate width, height, padding or margin; use transform, opacity, or a state swap.
Don't use colour alone to mark selection; the live tab, the stroke, and the readout name all change together.
